# Helix Workspace

> Communication, file storage and an authenticated MCP/CLI interface for scoped AI agents.

## Setup

- [Administrator checklist](admin-setup.md): domain, outgoing/incoming mail, MFA and agent onboarding.
- [AI agent setup instructions](agent-setup.md): connection, credentials, approvals, safe deployment and end-to-end checks.

- [External application integration](agent-integration.md): Helix Bot and other runners; MCP discovery, live events, chat, approvals, retries and presence.

Resolve relative links against this site's origin. These public instructions contain no credentials and grant no access.
